senses.sense_definition: An unborn human offspring in the early stages of development, typically from fertilization through the eighth week of pregnancy.

examples.text: Doctors monitor the health of the <w>embryo</w> during the first few weeks of pregnancy.
The <w>embryo</w> undergoes rapid cell division shortly after fertilization occurs.

senses.sense_definition: An organism in the earliest stages of development after fertilization, before it becomes a fetus or hatches.

examples.text: The <w>embryo</w> is protected by the shell until it is ready to hatch.
Researchers study the <w>embryo</w> to understand how different species develop.

senses.sense_definition: The part of a seed that develops into a new plant.

examples.text: The seed contains a tiny <w>embryo</w> that will grow into a tree.
Water is necessary to activate the <w>embryo</w> inside the seed.

senses.sense_definition: The earliest, undeveloped stage of an idea, project, or plan.

examples.text: The new business idea was still in <w>embryo</w> when they presented it to investors.
His plan for the novel was in <w>embryo</w> for several years before he started writing.
